description: Partial-wave unitarity bounds on Cloud-9 resonance (A3, T174, 2026-09-21, corrected)
method: s-wave unitarity: σ_max(ℓ=0) = 4π/k_CM² = 16π/(m_χ² v²). For v=28 km/s, m_χ=10.44 GeV. Identical-particle combinatoric factor included. NR limit: k_CM = m_χ v/2.
note: Initial calculation used threshold formula σ_max = π/m² which is wrong for non-zero v. Corrected formula uses σ_max = 4π/k_CM² at finite v_rel. Cloud-9 peak is well below s-wave unitarity bound by factor ~10^-6. Resonance is perturbative.
